description: Creates a new contact in the account's Google Contacts and returns the created Person (resourceName, etag and the person_fields mask — use the resourceName for every later call). Provide any subset of the normalized fields: name parts, nickname, emails[], phones[], addresses[], organization, birthday, notes, urls[]; at least one is required. The API has NO duplicate detection — creating the same contact twice yields two contacts, so after an ambiguous failure (timeout/5xx; never auto-retried) check via search/list before re-sending. A just-created contact appears in list_contacts/get_contact immediately but reaches the search_contacts index with a delay. Contact photos need raw_request (updateContactPhoto).

addresses.description: Postal addresses. On update this list replaces ALL existing addresses; [] clears them.

birthday.description: Birthday: "YYYY-MM-DD", or "MM-DD" for a year-less birthday. On update "" clears it.

emails.description: Email addresses. On update this list replaces ALL existing emails; [] clears them.

notes.description: Free-text notes (the "Notes" field in Google Contacts). On update "" clears it.

organization.description: Employer info. On update it replaces the existing organizations; {} clears them.

person_fields.description: Person fields to return (default names, emailAddresses, phoneNumbers, organizations, memberships). Only masked fields come back — an absent field may be unmasked, not empty.

phones.description: Phone numbers. On update this list replaces ALL existing phones; [] clears them.

urls.description: Websites. On update this list replaces ALL existing urls; [] clears them.

name: create_contact
title: Create a contact
